description: Large lever shears clamped in a press to cut board roughly to size before final trimming. The straight arm is fixed in the press so the operator's hand is not bruised against the work.
name: millboard shears

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter IX, p.126. Internet Archive.
